summary: Busy kerb of parked cars beside UQ playing fields; no homes nearby.
reasons: Backs onto open fields and courts

drivers.seclusion: Open grass field and tennis courts on this side; only university and pool buildings nearby, no dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane with a row of cars already parked along it; level, sealed.
drivers.traffic: Campus road with steady daytime traffic; quieter overnight.
drivers.convention: Cars line the kerb; a van would not stand out.

flags: Signs mark a Mon-Fri 7am-9pm metered parking area
Low-lying: about 6 m elevation, Brisbane River 133 m away
Bus set-down zone with No Stopping at the start
Noise from campus and aquatic centre events
sun_shade: Open to sun all day; a few palms and trees shade patches at the south-west end.

best_section.where: North kerb of Blair Drive beside the grass field, opposite the aquatic centre
